en.headline: Taxi driver arrested after crash injures family of three in Tai Po
en.dek: A 31-year-old driver was detained on suspicion of furious driving and driving while his licence was suspended after the vehicle hit a curb near Fu Heng Estate early Saturday.
body: A taxi driver was arrested early on Saturday after the vehicle crashed into a curb in Tai Po, injuring a family of three passengers, police said.

The incident occurred around 2.47 am as the taxi was turning left from Chung Nga Road into Fu Heng Estate. The 31-year-old driver, surnamed Chan, lost control and the vehicle hit the road curb. The passengers — a 42-year-old man, his 40-year-old wife and their seven-year-old son — suffered injuries to the head, chest, waist and face. They were conscious and taken to Prince of Wales Hospital.

The driver reported pain in the chest, hand and foot and was taken to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital. He was arrested on suspicion of furious driving and driving while his licence was suspended, and is being detained for questioning.

zh.headline: 大埔的士失控撞路邊 三口家傷 司機涉危險駕駛及停牌期間駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 31歲姓陳司機清晨在富亨邨附近失控撞路邊，三名乘客受傷送院；司機涉嫌瘋狂駕駛及在停牌期間駕駛被扣查。
body: 警方表示，一名的士司機星期六清晨在大埔失控撞向路邊，導致車上三口家受傷，司機其後被捕。
意外約於凌晨2時47分發生，的士沿頌雅路左轉入富亨邨時，31歲姓陳司機疑失控撞向路邊石壆。車上42歲男乘客、40歲妻子及7歲兒子頭部、胸部、腰部及面部受傷，清醒送往威爾斯親王醫院。
司機胸部、手及腳疼痛，送往雅麗氏何妙齡那打素醫院。他涉嫌瘋狂駕駛及在停牌期間駕駛被捕，正被扣查。
